hypothesis: A SNDK Swing/HA source evaluation blocked only by pivot_break_state_missing may retain a repeatable after-cost directional opportunity. Measure both long and short sides after the frozen 2026-08-09T09:00:00Z cutoff with a 75-minute accepted-entry spacing, adverse recorded BBO entry and exit, observed funding and taker fees, an 80-bps stop proxy, no target, no order-pressure cohort gate, and a fixed 60-minute horizon.
decision: Freeze a report-only prospective observer at the next completed 15-minute boundary after hypothesis formation. Do not change the live v25 pivot requirement and do not execute the candidate. The discovery evidence is one independent short path that returned +34.4065 bps at 15 minutes with +36.0449 bps favorable excursion, but the same path was -8.2203 bps at five minutes. That contradiction is sufficient to justify prospective measurement, not route promotion. Future evidence must retain both-side attribution, independent spacing, adverse BBO capacity, fees, funding, and the exact v25 source contract.
falsifier: Reject or materially revise the challenger if post-cutoff after-cost return is nonpositive excluding the largest winner, independent episodes do not recur, evidence remains one-sided, long outcomes are adverse, the result depends on an OPI subset selected after observation, visible-book capacity fails, or source/profile/cutoff identity changes. Evidence strengthens only through independent both-side post-cutoff paths with positive after-cost economics excluding the largest winner; no observation grants live authority automatically.
limitations: Hypothesis formation is one independent short-side path from one live market window.
The favorable 15-minute result conflicts with the adverse five-minute result and does not establish a stable holding horizon.
The observer changes one source blocker and therefore is not the deployed Swing/HA contract.
Recorded BBO feasibility is not authenticated private queue position or a counterfactual venue fill.
The fixed 60-minute horizon isolates entry quality and is not an adaptive production exit policy.
The candidate is report-only and cannot enter, close, resize, gate, rank, pause, or promote a live strategy.
